# Browser test dependency

`p5.waves-3.4.0.min.js` is the unmodified MIT-licensed p5.waves 3.4.0 file from:

https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/seb-prjcts-be/p5.waves@v3.4.0/p5.waves.min.js

SHA-256: `9bd3344078739f4d234b98073e70bcf2a5802a404c51f626be5de5da4c25b28f`.

Its existing copyright and license header is preserved. Browser tests serve this fixture and the pinned npm p5 2.2.2 package locally, so geometry comparisons do not depend on third-party availability. This fixture is not included in the penplotter bundles.
